name: incremental-implementation
description: Implement thin vertical slices end-to-end. Each slice = implement → test → verify → commit. Use feature flags for safe rollouts. Keep changes rollback-friendly. Each slice independently deployable. Inspired by agent-skills.

inputs.name: taskList
inputs.description: Ordered list of atomic tasks from spec-driven-development.

outputs.name: commitLog
outputs.description: List of commits: hash, message, files changed, tests passed.

failureConditions.signal: test suite fails after implementing a slice
single slice touches > 5 files or > 200 lines
implementation continued without committing the previous slice
